blocks.text: 2. Does a trigger address the recorded objection?

The dossier also has no evidence that the security and GDPR materials were sent or that the assessment started. The objection is therefore unresolved, and nothing here shows budget or permission has appeared.

No reconnection draft is generated. The only candidate triggers are indirect or context-only and do not touch the blocker, so a reconnection now would rest on the M&A news alone, which is not a real reason to revisit this proposal.
